name: IBY_CREDITCARD_
description: IBY_CREDITCARD_ is the audit table for IBY_CREDITCARD. Table IBY_CREDITCARD contains records of the credit card details of the customers entered manually or imported through IBY_FNDCPT_SETUP_PUB.Create_Card API. This is the related table for Create Credit Card UI. This table stores information like credit card number, expiry date, card holder's name, billing address, card brand, purchase card subtype, inactive date, etc.
